adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a large, sustained step at index ~584 (N from ~6 to ~21, E from ~2 to ~20, U from ~-2 to ~-5), followed by gradual motion but no opposing return across the same axes within the candidate intervals. P1 and P2 have similar onset offsets (~13,16,-2.5) suggesting they reflect the same step, but interior observations (e.g., indices 590–640) show continued drift without reversal—no platform behavior. P3 has negligible N offset (-0.12) and smaller E/U offsets inconsistent with the dominant step; its start/end aligns with noisy interior, not a clean offset-return pair. Missing index at 635 breaks continuity, and numerical tool evidence rejects the best candidate (P2-like) due to nuisance steps at 584, 616, 631. No sustained shift+opposing return observed; thus no genuine temporary platform.
